name: Default
shortDescription: Turns a media library into scheduled live TV channels, served to IPTV clients as M3U playlists with an XMLTV guide.

alerts.message: The web UI has no login by default: anyone with the URL can manage channels and media sources. Set OIDC__AUTHORITY, OIDC__CLIENTID and OIDC__CLIENTSECRET to an OpenID Connect provider and register https://<your domain>/callback as its redirect URI to require sign-in.
IPTV endpoints (M3U, XMLTV, HDHomeRun and the streams themselves) are never authenticated, even with OIDC enabled. Anyone who knows the URL can watch your channels.
No host media folder is mounted. Add a Plex, Jellyfin or Emby server as a media source; its items are streamed from that server by default.
